verified: edh-zones-3 review, by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings and the rules (trg.when, eff.draw.you, kw.line, eff.t6.shuffle.graveyardInto.player; lower/trigger-zone.ts; CR 603.6c, 113.6k, 400.3, 701.24a, 111.7, 603.3a): the cast trigger and annihilator were already automated; "When ~ is put into a graveyard from anywhere" names no origin zone, so it is never a leaves-the-battlefield ability (603.6c) and functions in the graveyard the card arrived in (zone graveyard, 113.6k), for any origin (destroyed, discarded, milled, countered); its OWNER (the card's, not its last controller's) moves every card of their graveyard, itself included, into their library and shuffles it. A token copy triggers it before it ceases to exist (111.7, triggers/collect.ts).
